SUP-C,Meccanica Chisone S.r.l.,aluminium extrusions and blanks
Agreed in writing with Aurelia (F. Marino).

findings.why: SUP-C was re-approved as a company on 2026-11-06, which does not release any part. No controlled record in the documents covers SUP-C for HS-410 at a receiving plant for Aurelia. The supplier's commodity is aluminium extrusions and blanks, while HS-410 is a stamped DC04 steel part. Absence of a record is not proof that SUP-C is not approved, so someone must confirm whether a part, plant and customer release exists.
